# HTTP endpoints

<!-- Generated by scripts/export_openapi.py from the FastAPI app. Do not edit by hand. -->

Address Standardizer Microservice API 3.3.0, OpenAPI 3.1.0. The raw schema is [openapi.json](openapi.json); a running server also serves interactive docs at `/docs`.

High-performance universal address standardization, pure offline rooftop geocoding, CASS Cycle N deliverability verification, and real-time typeahead autocomplete daemon.

## Endpoints

### `GET /health`

**Health and readiness probe**

Returns microservice health, engine capability matrix, and cache telemetry.

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `any` |

### `GET /metrics`

**Service telemetry and metrics**

Returns runtime throughput, request counts, and execution latencies.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `format` | query | `string` or `null` | no | Metric format: 'json' or 'prometheus' |

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `any` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` `HTTPValidationError` |

### `GET /ready`

**Readiness probe**

Readiness: 200 when the cache, audit ledger and reference database are usable, else 503 (names only).

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `any` |

### `POST /v1/autocomplete`

**Typeahead address autocomplete**

Real-time typeahead address suggestion with secondary unit prompting and proximity biasing.

Request body (`application/json`): `AutocompleteRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `AutocompleteResponse` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` `HTTPValidationError` |

### `POST /v1/batch`

**High-throughput batch standardization**

Batch standardize a collection of addresses with support for JSON arrays and streaming NDJSON.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `format` | query | `string` or `null` | no | Optional format: 'json' or 'ndjson' |

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `any` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` `HTTPValidationError` |

### `POST /v1/standardize`

**Standardize single address**

Standardize a single address string or structured address fields with sub-2ms latency.

Declared as a plain function so FastAPI runs the CPU-bound work in its threadpool instead of
blocking the event loop (and every other request, including /health).

Request body (`application/json`): `StandardizeRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` `StandardizeResponse` |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` `HTTPValidationError` |

## Schemas

### `AutocompleteRequest`

Payload for real-time typeahead address suggestion.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Partial address input string |
| `max_results` | `integer` | no | Max suggestions to return |
| `state_filter` | `string` or `null` | no | US State postal filter (e.g. CA, NY) |
| `latitude` | `number` or `null` | no | Client latitude for proximity ranking |
| `longitude` | `number` or `null` | no | Client longitude for proximity ranking |
| `radius_miles` | `number` or `null` | no | Proximity radius bounding in miles |

### `AutocompleteResponse`

List of autocomplete suggestions.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `suggestions` | array of `AutocompleteSuggestionItem` | yes |  |
| `count` | `integer` | yes |  |

### `StandardizeRequest`

Input payload for single address standardization.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `address` | `string` or `null` | no | Single-line address string |
| `street1` | `string` or `null` | no | Primary street line |
| `street2` | `string` or `null` | no | Secondary unit (Suite, Apt, Floor) |
| `city` | `string` or `null` | no | City / Locality name |
| `state` | `string` or `null` | no | State / Province code |
| `postal_code` | `string` or `null` | no | Postal / ZIP code |
| `country` | `string` or `null` | no | Country name or ISO-3166 code |
| `enable_geocoding` | `boolean` | no | Enable offline rooftop/TIGER geocoding |
| `enable_fuzzy` | `boolean` | no | Enable Levenshtein typo correction |
| `allow_locality` | `boolean` | no | Allow locality-only / city-level fallback |
| `correct_state_from_zip` | `boolean` | no | Replace a US state that contradicts the ZIP with the ZIP's state (reported as WARN_STATE_CORRECTED_FROM_ZIP). Off by default: a mismatching state is kept and the address is flagged ERR_ZIP_STATE_MISMATCH / UNDELIVERABLE. |
| `include_metadata` | `boolean` | no | Include delivery intelligence and spatial metadata |
| `include_explanation` | `boolean` | no | Add `explanation` (ordered change records) and `field_confidence` (per-field, heuristic) to the response. |
| `alternatives` | `integer` | no | Add up to N next-best interpretations of an ambiguous input as `alternatives`. |
